headline: Neither dollars nor euros: which currency Ukrainians prefer to keep their money in banks
summary: A report examines how much money Ukrainians hold in bank accounts and which currency they prefer, with dollars and euros compared.
why: Currency preferences in household deposits indicate confidence in the local currency and affect the funding base of Ukrainian banks. Deposit flows matter for lenders and monetary policy.
